parallel.requirements: Recognized the task as implementing PyQuery 2.0.x behavior from the prompt and upstream/reference sources, including packaging, selectors, traversal, forms, text extraction, and web scraping behavior.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent owned implementation and local verification, created tracker tasks, then delegated a broad six-area spec audit workflow after local tests passed.
parallel.implementation: Copied a reference PyQuery tree, patched lxml and opener compatibility, adjusted packaging and API exports, and added local test coverage.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: Wrote the package, tests, docs, and packaging files into the shared workspace; artifact validation later copied a complete workspace for official evaluation.
parallel.verification: Reached 150 local pytest passes and then launched the workflow audit for deeper spec checks, but the workflow never returned an aggregate result.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: The workflow was killed with result null and final.txt empty; the official evaluator still failed six of seventy-four tests.

serial.requirements: Recognized the same PyQuery implementation task and pursued compatibility with upstream 2.0.1/2.0.2 behavior, package metadata, docs, tests, and hidden evaluator needs.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single parent owned all implementation, package edits, local probes, local test additions, and delivery without any delegated workflow or subagent.
serial.implementation: Copied upstream/reference code, patched HTML parser compatibility, opener headers, serialization, value handling, setup metadata, exports, and CSS getter behavior.
serial.integration_and_delivery: Kept all changes in one workspace and official artifact validation copied a complete workspace including package files, docs, tests, and egg-info.
serial.verification: Ran the local suite to 151 and then 152 passes, built a documented-example script that eventually passed, and added focused local tests.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The run also timed out with an empty final response and the official evaluator still failed six of seventy-four tests.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The parallel parent owned implementation tasks and then created a workflow audit with six parallel audit areas.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: The serial run had workflows disabled and no delegation; one parent owned all work.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel decomposed post-implementation verification into subagents, while serial kept all work in a single actor.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: The workflow script supplied shared PyQuery context, project files, read-only rules, and area-specific audit prompts to children.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child briefs or handoff interfaces because workflows and task tools were denied.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel introduced child prompt and return interfaces for audit findings; serial avoided those interfaces entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel copied a reference implementation, fixed lxml and opener behavior, adjusted exports, packaging, and tests.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also copied upstream/reference code and patched parser, opener, serialization, setup, exports, CSS, and tests locally.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both implementation paths are very similar reference-and-patch strategies; serial continued more local example verification after the point where parallel launched the workflow audit.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel launched an audit workflow after local tests passed, but the workflow state ended killed with result null while child agents were in progress.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no workflow result lifecycle; its verification outputs were local command results visible to the parent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel lost a delegated audit result before finalization, while serial had no delegated result to join.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel wrote a complete workspace artifact with package, docs, tests, wheels, and cache files recorded by artifact validation.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial wrote a comparable complete workspace artifact and included generated egg-info after local packaging checks.
comparison_dimensions.difference: No concrete concurrent write collision is evidenced; the shared-state difference is the extra parallel workflow logs, not conflicting workspace writes.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel reached a local 150-passed result before launching the workflow audit, then official evaluation completed at 68/74.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial reached 151 and then 152 local passes, got documented examples OK, then official evaluation also completed at 68/74.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Serial kept verification local and advanced it further; parallel attempted delegated audit verification but lost the workflow result. The official outcome remained tied.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel exhausted the run budget with returncode 143 after the workflow had been launched and killed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial also exhausted the run budget with returncode 143, but without delegated children or workflow logs.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Both timed out, but only parallel spent the closure window with active workflow children whose aggregate result was null.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current completed official evaluations are not discordant: both parallel and serial failed with 68 of 74 tests passing. The main concrete task-solving difference is process-level verification: the parallel parent delegated a broad audit workflow after local tests passed, and that workflow was killed with no aggregate result, while the serial parent kept verification local and reached 152 local passes plus documented-example checks. That difference is adverse to the parallel process but does not explain a score difference because no score difference exists.

ordinary_implementation_differences: Both implementations still missed six official hidden or evaluator-aligned cases.
Serial added extra local checks after parallel had shifted verification into the workflow.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: no outcome difference; retained pattern is parallel adverse process evidence only
